premise: A cartographer is hired to survey a valley that appears on no two maps the same way.
tone: literary folk-horror mystery — quiet, landscape-haunted, unease over spectacle; the dread is in the measurements, not in monsters
orchestrator_lesson: The rolling summary must carry every figure a later chapter has to reproduce. Chapter 3 failed its gate because the compressed rolling summary dropped 'ten chains, fifty-three links', which chapters/ch02.summary.md had recorded correctly. The summary chain is the only channel between chapters, and compressing it is where a figure gets lost.
